lcc_original: 永恆主對該隱說：『你兄弟亞伯在哪裏？』他說：『我不知道。』我，我哪是看守我兄弟的呢？』
notes: 耶和華→永恆主: LCC uses 永恆主 as its rendering of the Tetragrammaton (YHWH); <WH03068> attached to the full phrase 永恆主 as a unit.
Emphatic pronoun 我，我: LCC doubles 我 to render the emphatic אָנֹכִי; <WAH0595> is placed after the second 我 since that is the grammatical subject of the predicate 哪是看守.

Punctuation divergence: LCC closes the first quotation after 知道。』 and opens the second clause (我，我哪是…) without a new opening quote, ending with 』. The original punctuation is preserved exactly; SN tags are only inserted within this existing structure.
在哪裡→在哪裏: orthographic variant (里/裏) only; SN placement identical.
